title: Perfectum (present perfect)
summary: Perfectum is formed with hebben/zijn (auxiliary) + past participle. Pattern: Subject + hebben/zijn + ge…t/d.
rules: Regular verbs: take the stem, add ge- in front, add -t or -d at the end.
Use -t after stems ending in K, F, S, T, CH, P (mnemonic: SOFTKETCHUPX or 't kofschip).
Use -d after all other stems (b, d, g, j, l, m, n, r, v, w, z, vowels).
If the stem ends in V, change to F before adding -d  → geverfd. If it ends in Z, change to S → gereisd.
Verbs starting with be-, ver-, her-, ont-, ge-, er- do NOT take ge- → betaald, verteld, herinnerd, ontmoet.
Most verbs use 'hebben' as auxiliary. Verbs of motion / change of state often use 'zijn' (gegaan, gekomen, geworden, gebleven, gestopt, geweest).
Irregular verbs have non-standard participles — memorise them (see irregular verb list).

examples.nl: Mijn vriend is naar Italië gereisd.
